verdict.rationale: The first-party manual says SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave, protected by Face ID or Touch ID. This covers every element of the story: SSH keys, hardware-backed enclave storage, and biometric protection. Keys can be generated or imported inside the app and attached to an Identity. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the enclave key setup flow and its limitations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
